description:
AI ENGINEER 

 Role Overview 

 The AI Engineer will design, build, and operationalize enterprise AI platform capabilities supporting Dutch Client’s agentic commerce ecosystem. This position focuses on hands-on engineering across orchestration, RAG, evaluation, observability, guardrails, and production AI deployments.  

 Key Responsibilities 

 AI Platform Engineering 

 
 Design and build multi-agent systems using LangGraph, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, or similar frameworks. 

 Implement knowledge and retrieval architectures incorporating vector search, embeddings, semantic retrieval, and memory services. 

 Develop enterprise-grade orchestration frameworks supporting autonomous and semi-autonomous workflows. 

 
 Evaluation & Governance 

 
 Build evaluation pipelines supporting faithfulness, hallucination detection, answer quality validation, latency monitoring, and guardrail testing. 

 Implement responsible AI controls, audit trails, observability, and governance frameworks. 

 
 Cloud Deployment 

 
 Deploy AI workloads using AWS Bedrock, Vertex AI, Azure AI Foundry, and associated cloud-native services. 

 Support production operations through monitoring, incident management, scaling, and performance optimization. 

 
 Experience 

 
 8+ years software engineering experience. 

 Strong hands-on GenAI implementation experience. 

 Production-scale AI deployment expertise.
